mapper.select: SELECT facility_id, name, zip_no, province_name, city_name, address, tel_no, main_sport, aver_rating, ST_Y(location) as latitude, ST_X(location) as longitude FROM facilities WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}

SELECT facility_id, name, zip_no, province_name, city_name, address, tel_no, main_sport, aver_rating, ST_Y(location) as latitude, ST_X(location) as longitude FROM facilities ORDER BY facility_id DESC LIMIT #{page.limit} OFFSET #{page.offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE facilities SET aver_rating = #{averRating} WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
